metadata.cache_policy: Reuse established Go and gopls caches; initialize and warm each retained MCP session before timing.
metadata.transport: Production MCP server over in-process JSON-RPC pipes; real external gopls.
metadata.budget_enforcement: Latency budgets report-only; exactly one gopls process start required.

limitations: One independent run with 1,000 timed calls per case; confidence intervals and cross-run variability are not measured.
Synthetic one-package and twenty-package Go fixtures; this does not establish performance on the repository or large projects.
Production MCP server over in-process JSON-RPC pipes; executable startup and OS stdio scheduling are excluded.
Real configured local gopls development build, identified by binary hash rather than a release version.
Aggregate benchmark output is retained; individual request samples, process CPU, and response byte counts are not retained.
Five read operations and exported-symbol rename are covered; file membership changes and other tool families remain unmeasured.
